planets.name: TOI-4495 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-4495 with a 2.57-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: TOI-4495 b was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-4495. Its orbit and size follow Wang et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
